Class RcxMotor

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx.RcxMotor
public final class RcxMotor extends Object
One or more of an RCX brick's outputs, driven with direct commands over infrared: get them from RemoteRcx.getMotorA(), RemoteRcx.getMotorB() and RemoteRcx.getMotorC(), and combine them with and(RcxMotor) so that several outputs start and stop in the same command, e.g. the two sides of a vehicle.

Each call is one or more commands that wait for the brick's acknowledgement when the IR receiver is wired, so it takes 100 ms or more; set a speed once and not in a tight loop.
